_comment: Machine-readable source-of-truth record. Release authorization (scripts/check-source-line.py) reads authoritativeLine + forbiddenBuildRefs only. historicalBaselines and ledger are permanent AUDIT EVIDENCE read by scripts/audit-branches.py; they never gate a release. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

authoritativeLine.note: Add 'main' here (deliberately, in a reviewed commit) when PR #1 is merged. A release source must be the tip of, or an ancestor of, one of these origin branches, and must be named by its full SHA.

forbiddenBuildRefs.why: legacy branch that auto-publishes OTAs; never a build or release source

historicalBaselines.name: build-39 source (last device build of the original app)

ledger.disposition: keep ref; do not merge. Its 3 unique commits were redone on the working branch (266c085 and later) and then rewritten in this line. See docs/BRANCH-LEDGER.md.
